olivia-pr: Heads-up: need final embargo window + analyst briefing schedule today. Also who owns the fact-check list?

ana-marketing: Proposal: US 11:00 PT / EU 20:00 UTC. APAC briefings on Fri morning. I'll update kit once confirmed.

evan-press: Short quote ready, will paste into kit after legal ok.

maria-analyst-relations: I can take EU Fri 9am GMT and APAC Fri 10am SGT. Need FAQ (10 Qs) + benchmark bullets by tomorrow 10:00 to prep.

jules-sales: Added demo link with UTM to kit: https://cal.com/redwood-demo?utm=press. Routing -> inbound-sales queue.

kevin-ops: Legal: include redaction clause for customer names. Otherwise green.

press-bot: Reminder set: embargo=11:00 PT / 20:00 UTC. Confirm by 17:00 PT.

olivia-pr: Action items: ana update embargo + kit, kevin add redaction clause, evan add one-line quote, maria will prep briefings once FAQ posted. I'll send reporter confirmations at 17:00 PT. Thanks!
